title: Mother with Baby in Pram, House Porch Lawn - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Captured in the bright sunlight of July 14, 1932, during the Great Depression, this tender snapshot shows a joyful young mother interacting with her infant seated in a vintage cloth pram. She sports a popular 1930s finger-waved bob haircut, a striped sleeveless daytime dress with button accents, and strapped Mary Jane shoes. In the background, the wooden railings and siding of a family home porch are lined with garden foliage.
